result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue: a truncated/garbled restaurant name in the Popular section. The horizontally scrollable partial items and bottom cut-off content were excluded as intentional features.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Rameı' in the 'Popular right now' section appears truncated/garbled, with its final character clipped/rendered as a dotless vertical stroke instead of the complete name, despite available spacing issues with the rating on the same row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the full restaurant name is displayed correctly; if space with the rating is limited, truncate cleanly with an ellipsis and allow the name to wrap or shrink rather than clipping a character mid-glyph.
